notes:
POC focused on Dedicated capacity: Polaris runs low-latency real-time pricing and reranking for search results across retail and derivatives products. Primary ask: throughput guarantees and latency SLOs at reserved capacity.

Key ask summary (from Prod/Infra lead):
- 95p latency <= 150ms for 512-token responses under steady-state traffic (avg request size ~256 tokens).
- Burst support to 2.5x reserved throughput for Black Friday-like events, with fast fallback to smaller model variant.
- Deterministic KV/prefix cache behavior for stateful sessions (important for personalization and pricing).
- Audit logs, KMS integration for key management, and contract-level data residency in NA and EU.

POC requirements (customer-defined):
- Representative prompt set provided (attached): pricing_calculation, multi-step dialogue for negotiation, top-10 rerank inputs.
- Load tests: ramp to 400 concurrent requests (avg 256 tokens) to validate throughput and 95p latency.
- Soak test: 48 hour run at 65% reserved capacity to detect memory leaks/gradual latency drift.
- Failure injection: simulate 25% node loss to verify smart routing/fallback to warm variants.
- End-to-end metrics: per-token cost estimates, tail-latency (95/99), KV cache hit rates, and GPU utilization.

Customer quote (POC kickoff call): "We need predictable latency and a clear plan for reserved GPUs — can't have surprise throttles during peak trading windows."

Negotiation points flagged by procurement:
- Want 99.95% uptime SLA for Dedicated pools or credits tiered to downtime minutes.
- Clear definition of "burst capacity" and billing for overflow.
- Penalties if routing to hosted/shared tiers occurs without advance notice.

Technical notes from SE:
- Proposed baseline: 8x H100-equivalent GPUs (M-class) with autoscale headroom to +50% for bursts; consider smaller quantized variant (4-bit) for overflow routing.
- Expectation: prefix/KV caching should reduce effective tokens by ~18% for chat flows — will instrument counters in POC.
- Workload classification: mix of short (32-64 tokens) and medium (200-512 tokens); planning for 90% of requests <512.

Actionable POC plan (short):
- Deliverables: load test scripts (k6 + custom harness), prompt corpus, instrumentation dashboard, soak-test report, cost model.
- Run window: week-of-2026-02-22 (load + soak), with preliminary report within 5 business days after completion.
- SE tasks: configure Dedicated pool, provide recommended kernel/quantization settings, enable audit log stream to customer's SIEM test collector.
